sidebyside.p: We can plot this by finding the x-intercept, which is at {\left(3,0\right)}\text{,} and the y-intercept, which is at {\left(0,-7\right)}\text{.} After plotting these, we can just connect the dots and extend the line past them. It is highly recommended to do some quality control by checking that a few more points on the line youve drawn actually satisfy the equation.
